correction.zh: 塔洛斯不属于《伊利亚特》正文。正式事件应以阿波罗尼奥斯·罗迪乌斯《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷为主要古典文本依据。
correction.en: Talos is not part of the Iliad text. The formal event should use Book 4 of Apollonius Rhodius's Argonautica as its principal classical source.

correction.zh: 原清单作者为伊恩·班克斯，所指应是 The Culture 科幻系列，而不是席德·梅尔的 Civilization 游戏系列。正式展示已改为“文化”系列，并替换人物、正文与肖像。
correction.en: The source list names Iain Banks, so the entry refers to the Culture science-fiction series rather than Sid Meier's Civilization games. The displayed title, figure, text and portrait have been corrected.
